$comment: Public, non-secret Robinhood Chain Mainnet deployment identity for clog.run. Tracked in git deliberately - see docs/DEPLOYMENTS.md for why (this exists specifically so a stale .env.production on the VPS can never silently override which deployment the frontend reads from after a git pull). Contains ONLY public contract addresses, chain id, and deployment block - never secrets, never a database URL, never a signer key. Edit this file (and only this file) to point the frontend at a different deployment; no other source file should ever hardcode a contract address.

$notReadByFrontend.$comment: Recorded for operational completeness. These values are not read by the Next.js frontend itself.

$verification.$comment: V2 deployed and verified incrementally against live Robinhood Chain and Arbitrum One RPCs. Core wiring, cross-chain provider/wrapper wiring, VRF subscription consumer membership, provider funding and a non-persistent requestRandomness simulation were checked before switching this manifest to V2.
$verification.verifiedBy: operator via staged live RPC checks
